title: console: one open reads the same metadata resource through two or three client caches (成员: meta/object/sys_member, sys_organization, sys_user ×2; 环境: meta/view ×3)
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from objectstack-ai/cloud#2914 round 6 (dev report `6266910210`). ⛔ Not a claim: the objectui lane dispatches it.

**How it was measured:**
- The rig ran cloud `eca60c38` (framework `fb9c22aa`, objectui `47508f3b`) on `run-stack --prod-like --with-ui --seed`.
- The subject was an ordinary organization owner. Each page got one warm-up, then 8 full warm opens, counted from the page's performance entries.
- Producers were found from CDP initiator stacks, mapped through a hidden-sourcemap build that is byte-identical to the served console.
- The maintainer's staging reading `6265264751` shows the same duplicate paths.

## What was measured (8/8 opens, identical full URLs)

**成员 (`page/team`):** `meta/object/sys_member`, `meta/object/sys_organization` and `meta/object/sys_user` are each read twice.
- **First read:** `packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx:891` (per item; see also `:979`, `:1327`). It is asked by `console/appObjectScope.ts:172-178` and `:287` for `console/AppContent.tsx:401`, the page route's object scope. It lands before the splash leaves.
- **Second read:** `data-objectstack` `src/index.ts:5211` `getObjectSchema`, through `src/cache/MetadataCache.ts:148` and `src/index.ts:5272` `fetchObjectSchemaFresh`. The callers are:
  - `plugin-detail` `src/renderers/recordBinding.tsx:401` (`sys_organization`);
  - `react` `src/hooks/useSettledSchema.ts:206` (`sys_member`);
  - `fields` `src/index.tsx:131` (`sys_user`).

  This read comes after the splash. Two client caches hold the same key.

**环境 (the `sys_environment` list):** `/api/v1/meta/view` is read 3 times.
- `providers/MetadataProvider.tsx:802`: the eager view type at boot (`:1236`, `:1245`).
- `data-objectstack` `src/index.ts:5636` `listViews`, from `views/ObjectView.tsx:1931`.
- `data-objectstack` `src/index.ts:5517` `listViewOverrides` through `MetadataCache.ts:148`, from `views/ObjectView.tsx:963` and `:2002`.

Calls per full open on the rig: 成员 32, the 环境 list 28.

## Target

objectstack-ai/cloud#2914's Target 1 asks for one call per resource per open, through one request-key cache in the console's data layer. `MetadataProvider` and `MetadataCache` should share one in-flight promise per URL, so a resource that one already holds or is fetching is not asked for again.

## Acceptance

- One full open of 成员 reads each `meta/object/NAME` once.
- One full open of the 环境 list reads `meta/view` once.
- A test pins one request per key across both caches, with an ablation.
